keyword: stations of the cross good friday
claims: The Stations of the Cross on Good Friday is a 14-step devotion retracing Jesus’ final steps to his crucifixion.
Jesus is condemned to death is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus takes up his cross is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus falls the first time is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus meets his mother, Mary is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Simon of Cyrene helps to carry the cross is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Veronica wipes the face of Jesus is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus falls the second time is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus meets the women of Jerusalem is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus falls the third time is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus is stripped of his clothing is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus is nailed to the cross is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus dies on the cross is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus is taken down from the cross is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
Jesus is laid in the tomb is one of the 14 Stations of the Cross.
In Rome, the Pope traditionally leads the Way of the Cross at the Colosseum.
The 2026 Good Friday marks a rare occasion where the Pope carried the cross for all 14 stations.
3 PM is the hour of Jesus' death.
